strategy_lines.label: Audience
strategy_lines.text: Third-party logistics providers in the US Southeast with 5 to 50 warehouses, running a legacy WMS. Roles: COO, VP Operations, Director of IT.

strategy_lines.label: Offer
strategy_lines.text: The Dock-to-Stock Calculator. The buyer enters their receiving volumes and gets the hours a day a modern WMS gives back. CTA: Get your calculation.

strategy_lines.label: Message
strategy_lines.text: Orchard Lane cuts dock-to-stock time from 48 hours to 6 for 3PLs moving off a legacy WMS. Proof: Two 3PL pilots hit 6 hours within 30 days.

strategy_lines.label: Channel: Google search ads
strategy_lines.text: Google search ads (paid search), $24,000 at $120 a lead

strategy_lines.label: Channel: LinkedIn ads
strategy_lines.text: LinkedIn ads (paid social), $16,000 at $160 a lead (Assumption)

strategy_lines.label: Tracking
strategy_lines.text: HubSpot campaign OL-D2S-27 on every lead. Opportunities credited to the first campaign touch.

strategy_lines.label: Funnel
strategy_lines.text: Average deal $20,000 (Assumption), 10% (Assumption) of leads become opportunities in 21 days (Assumption)
